You must be free of notice period obligations by 1 December. If you are serving a 60 or 90-day notice, the timing will not work and we cannot make an exception.

**Please read this advertisement to the end before you apply. It is long on purpose — it tells you exactly what the job is, what it is not, and what we will not budge on.**

**WHO WE ARE:**

Jane Aerospace is a Bengaluru-based aerospace and drone supply chain company. We source aircraft parts, drone components and industrial materials for operators, MROs and manufacturers, and we are building Supply Chain as a Service — a subscription model in which we take over a client’s procurement function entirely.

We run three companies across India, Hong Kong and the UAE. We are bootstrapped, no outside funding and none being sought, and people here own real things early.

**THE ROLE:**

**We are hiring three full-stack engineers to join our in-house engineering team. There are two senior engineers here already. The three of you would make it a team of five, and between you that team is responsible for everything this company runs on.**

The main build is the SCaaS platform — the software the subscription business runs on, and the system our clients use. Broadly it covers the client-facing side where a customer raises a requirement and watches it move; the sourcing side where suppliers are matched, quotes compared and decisions recorded; and the operations side underneath — fulfilment, documentation, landed cost, and the integrations that keep everything in step.

Alongside it sit our hiring and assessment platform and our marketing tooling, both already running, and whatever we decide to build next. Five people, several products.

**Which part you own is decided after you join, not before.**
We are not allocating modules at offer stage — we would be guessing, and we would probably guess wrong. The first few weeks are how we find out where each of you is strongest. Apply as a full-stack engineer, not as a specialist in one corner; all three of you are assessed the same way.

**One thing we want to be honest about.**
Five engineers carrying three platforms is a broad surface for a small team. You will context-switch more than you would at a larger company, you will work outside whatever you consider your specialism, and some weeks the priority will change under you.

**There is also no QA function. You test what you ship. Code review is real — our two senior engineers and your peers review everything, nobody merges their own work including the founder, and AI-assisted architecture and security review runs as a formal gate — but nobody downstream is going to catch a bug you did not look for.**

What you get in exchange is unusual at this level: two seniors to learn from, real ownership of a production system from the first month, and your work in front of paying clients. If the work grows faster than five people can carry, we expect to hire again around March.

**WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO:**

* Build and ship to production, weekly. We would rather see something working on Friday than something perfect next month.
* Own your part of the platform — its architecture, uptime, backups, security, and the decisions about where it goes next.
* Test your own work. There is no QA function here and we are not pretending otherwise.
* Review code and have yours reviewed, by the senior engineers and by your peers.
* Integrate substantial third-party APIs, primarily the Zoho suite, and LLM APIs for the AI tooling we run internally.
* Demo working software to the Managing Director every Friday. Thirty minutes, running software, not a status update.
* Write things down — standards, decisions and runbooks — so the next person is not reverse-engineering your head.

**WHAT YOU GET PAID:**

Rs 40,000 to Rs 45,000 per month CTC (Rs 4.8–5.4 lakh per annum), depending on experience and on what you can demonstrate you have built. CTC means cost to company; your in-hand figure will be lower after statutory deductions, and we will show you the exact breakdown at offer stage.

* A laptop, the tools you need including AI tooling, and a learning budget.
* PF and ESI as per statute.
